title: actor.deactivate — Request
description: Deactivate an agent session credential. This verb targets agent sessions only: it revokes and ends the targeted agent session credential without erasing runtime metadata or parent-child traceability. Idempotent via operation_id: the same operation_id replays the cached response; the same operation_id with a different request body returns a conflict. The verb is also domain-idempotent for an already-deactivated agent session. The last-active-human protection from actor.revoke_token does not apply here because this verb is not used for human credentials.

operation_id.description: UUIDv7 (time-ordered) recommended. Same operation_id replays the cached response. Same operation_id with a different request body returns 409 Conflict.

actor_id.description: UUID of the agent session to deactivate. Human credentials are out of scope for this verb.
